setupDAQ.py
This script sets up a Data Acquisition (DAQ) task using NI-DAQmx in
It defines which channels to use, the timing of the acquisition,
and how the DAQ system starts and stops.
Import the NI-DAQmx Python library.
Create a new task object which will manage all DAQ operations.
Add a voltage input channel (AI0) on device Dev1.
Set the voltage range to ±10V for analog signal acquisition.
Configure the task to acquire samples continuously.
Set the sampling rate to 1000 samples per second (1 kHz).
Start the task. The DAQ device begins acquiring data.
Insert your acquisition logic here.
Example: read data from the buffer, process it, or log it to a file.
Stop the task after acquisition is done.
Close and release the task resources.
- Analog input channel AI0 is now configured with ±10V range.
- Task is set to acquire data continuously at 1000 samples/sec.
- This setup can be reused for DAQ loops, real-time monitoring, or
socket communication
